file: teams.json is a plain list of team objects

competitions.UCL: UEFA Champions League 2026/27 league phase (36 clubs)
competitions.UEL: UEFA Europa League 2026/27 league phase (36 clubs)

fields.name: long name in plain ASCII (Outcome or ESPN spelling, official form). Look teams up by name or alias, not by short.
fields.short: what fans call it (Man City, PSG, Spurs, Rams). Not unique across sports.
fields.code: three letters. Soccer: unique within the soccer set. NBA: official tricodes. NFL: Pro-Football-Reference style where ESPN uses two letters (GNB, KAN, LVR, NWE, NOR, SFO, TAM, WAS). Same code can exist in two sports (ATL, CHI, MIA...).
fields.code_espn: abbreviation ESPN uses (what Outcome shows for some NFL teams: KC, LV, TB, NO)
fields.primary / secondary: hex. teamcolorcodes.com: first listed colour, and the next listed colour that is visibly different (CIE76 delta E >= 20); a few clubs swapped where TCC lists crest colours first (colour_note says which). Clubs with no TCC page: ESPN colour fields, corrected from the Wikipedia home kit where ESPN is clearly wrong.
fields.colours: every colour the source lists, in order
fields.on_dark: derived: first chromatic colour of primary/secondary/others, lightened if needed until contrast on #0B0C0F is at least 4.5:1. Use this for accents on Outcome dark backgrounds.
fields.colour_confidence: high = teamcolorcodes.com page for that team; medium = ESPN checked against the Wikipedia kit or a sister page; low = ESPN only, could not be confirmed
fields.country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase; England gb-eng, Scotland gb-sct. Matches the file names in assets/flags.
fields.league: domestic league (NFL and NBA for those). competitions: which of UCL, UEL, EPL, NFL, NBA the team is in this season.
fields.aliases: other spellings: Outcome strings, ESPN names, Wikipedia names, with and without accents. The 24 Outcome spellings from the brief are always present, even when equal to name.

participants: studio/data/archive/meta/20261013-1028.json (live Outcome market definitions, 13 Oct 2026: all 36 UCL clubs and 16 of the UEL clubs, exact spellings)
ESPN site API: uefa.champions, uefa.europa, eng.1, nfl, nba team lists (36, 36, 20, 32, 30 teams)
Wikipedia: 2026-27 UEFA Champions League, 2026-27 UEFA Europa League, 2026-27 Premier League (league phase tables). All three agree.
sources.names_codes: ESPN displayName and abbreviation, Outcome market text, codes assigned by hand (see fields.code)
sources.colours: teamcolorcodes.com team pages (fetched 13 Oct 2026, 116 pages one at a time: 114 teams plus the Fenerbahce Basketball and Olympiacos B.C. pages). Where no page exists: ESPN API colour fields with Wikipedia 2026-27 home kit corrections. Per-team source in colour_source / colour_source_url.
sources.country_league: Wikipedia club articles and the UEFA 2026-27 pages (Torreense is in Liga Portugal 2, qualified as cup winners)

not_included: MLB (Outcome has MLB championship markets: Dodgers, Yankees, Brewers, Rays, Phillies, Braves, Red Sox, Cubs)
